published_prior_art.cite: BanerjeeWellner2001 gives the one-location LR functional; HooghiemstraLopuhaa1998 and DurotKulikovLopuhaa2012 concern distinct argmax/slope-error extrema.
Doss2026PointwiseLR is fixed-dose LR inference; WestlingGilbertCarone2020 supplies causal isotonic pointwise theory, not an extreme-scale continuum transfer.
TakatsuWestling2025 gives Gaussian uniform bands for a debiased local-linear procedure, not plug-in Gumbel calibration of an isotonic LR spatial clock.
No verified paper derives the Palm excursion intensity or marked Poisson law for the Brownian--GCM LR-energy field.

soundness_flags.label: lem:causal-identification and target_estimand
soundness_flags.one_line: Consistency, pointwise exchangeability, and a smooth observed conditional-mean version do not identify E[Y(a)] at every exact continuous dose: Y(a0) can be changed at any null-probability dose a0 without changing P or the listed assumptions.

soundness_flags.label: def:excursion-regime / aT / feasible critical values
soundness_flags.one_line: The asserted expansion only holds as u→∞ and permits arbitrary gamma_star, so it does not ensure that E_star is increasing or E_star'(b(T))>0 for every T>1 as required by the globally defined positive scale a(T).

source_verification_receipts.version: Author manuscript dated 20 July 2001; used as corroboration because the cited Annals PDF was not publicly inspectable
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The fixed-point likelihood-ratio limit is D=∫{S(z)^2-S0(z)^2}dz for Brownian motion plus quadratic drift and constrained/unconstrained GCM slopes.
The article studies extremal behavior on increasing intervals for stationary processes formed from the argmax of two-sided Brownian motion minus parabolic drift.
Under long-range and local dependence conditions, stationary-sequence exceedance processes have compound-Poisson cluster limits.
Causal isotonic regression generalizes least-squares isotonic regression, has irregular limit theory, and allows doubly robust inference.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv:2508.08415, 11 August 2025; corroborated by the JASA in-press record for doi:10.1080/01621459.2026.2639735
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The method constructs doubly robust likelihood-ratio-type confidence intervals for the monotone continuous treatment-effect curve at a fixed point, with cross-fitting variants.
The paper proposes a debiased local-linear estimator with pointwise inference and asymptotically valid uniform confidence bands based on empirical-process supremum approximation.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add a primitive full-data regularity condition, such as continuity of a↦E[Y(a)|W=w] with the observed smooth m as its continuous version, and restate/prove causal identification under that condition.

Define b(T) and a(T) only beyond an explicit deterministic T0 where the derived expansion is strictly increasing with positive derivative, or replace them by a monotone generalized inverse and positive eventual scale.

Before transfer work, resolve the canonical Palm question through a contact-set localization theorem or a falsifying simulation study that tests the proposed tail ratio, cluster intensity, and padding regime.

recommended_next_step: Revise the causal point-identification target and finite-T centering definitions, then advance the otherwise field-grade canonical-excursion kernel to Stage 0.
